items.caption: The Shuowen entry analyzes 姐 as 女 with 且 indicating its sound. This seal-script-style rendering shows those two components in the transmitted form.
items.alt: Black seal-script-style glyph with a 女-like form on the left and a tall 且-like form on the right.
items.selection_reason: The rendering is legible and illustrates the component analysis recorded in the Shuowen. It represents the transmitted seal-script tradition, not an excavated early form.

limitations.text: This is a modern digital reconstruction in a seal-script style, not a dated artifact. The evidence here does not establish an earlier excavated form or the graphic history before the Shuowen tradition.
